sealed_story_packet.headline: OpenShell puts enforceable permissions outside the agent
verified_visual_facts: An AI agent runs inside a sandboxed workload.
An external runtime supervisor enforces filesystem, process, network, service and credential policy.
Only policy-approved requests reach external services; blocked actions remain outside the service boundary.
Credentials remain outside the agent workload and are substituted only for approved destinations.
sealed_story_packet.visual_brief: A professional layered architecture plate with a central sandboxed agent, a surrounding external policy supervisor, separate network and credential checkpoints, approved services beyond the boundary, and clearly different allow and block paths.
sealed_story_packet.reference_policy: No reference image. Derive only from this sealed story packet; clean white textbook background, navy and cobalt system forms, amber decision accents, restrained green success accents.

prohibited_composition_patterns: single central icon with decorative orbit
